verses.geez: ወኀደሩ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ውስተ ፡ ሰጢም ፡ ወተገመነ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ ወዘመዉ ፡ በአዋልደ ፡ ሞአብ ።
verses.translation: And Israel sojourned in Sattin, and the people profaned itself by going a-whoring after the daughters of Moab.

translations.lxx: And Israel sojourned in Sattin, and the people profaned itself by going a-whoring after the daughters of Moab.
translations.kjv: And Israel abode in Shittim, and the people began to commit whoredom with the daughters of Moab.
translations.ron: Atunci s-a aşezat Israel în Sitim, dar poporul a început să se spurce, păcătuind cu fetele din Moab.
translations.grk: Καὶ κατέλυσεν Ἰσραὴλ ἐν Σαττεὶν, καὶ ἐβεβηλώθη ὁ λαὸς ἐκπορνεῦσαι εἰς τὰς θυγατέρας Μωάβ.

verses.geez: ወጸውዕዎሙ ፡ ውስተ ፡ መሥዋዕተ ፡ አማልክቲሆሙ ፡ ወበልዑ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ መሥዋዕቶሙ ፡ ወሰገዱ ፡ ለአማልክቲሆሙ ።
verses.translation: And they called them to the sacrifices of their idols; and the people ate of their sacrifices, and worshipped their idols.

translations.lxx: And they called them to the sacrifices of their idols; and the people ate of their sacrifices, and worshipped their idols.
translations.kjv: And they called the people unto the sacrifices of their gods: and the people did eat, and bowed down to their gods.
translations.ron: Că acestea îi chemau la jertfele idolilor lor şi mânca poporul din acele jertfe şi se închina la dumnezeii lor.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐκάλεσαν αὐτοὺς εἰς τὰς θυσίας τῶν εἰδώλων αὐτῶν· καὶ ἔφαγεν ὁ λαὸς τῶν θυσιῶν αὐτῶν, καὶ προσεκύνησαν τοῖς εἰδώλοις αὐτῶν·

verses.geez: ወተፈጸመ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ለቤዔል ፡ ፌጎር ፡ ወተምዕዐ ፡ መዐተ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ላዕለ ፡ እስራኤል ።
verses.translation: And Israel consecrated themselves to Beel-phegor; and the Lord was very angry with Israel.

translations.lxx: And Israel consecrated themselves to Beel-phegor; and the Lord was very angry with Israel.
translations.kjv: And Israel joined himself unto Baalpeor: and the anger of the LORD was kindled against Israel.
translations.ron: Aşa s-a lipit Israel de Baal-Peor, pentru care s-a aprins mânia lui Dumnezeu asupra lui Israel.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐτελέσθη Ἰσραὴλ τῷ Βεελφεγώρ· καὶ ὠργίσθη θυμῷ Κύριος τῷ Ἰσραήλ.

verses.geez:
ወይቤሎ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ ንሥኦሙ ፡ ለመላእክተ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ ወተዛለፎሙ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ [*በቅድመ ፡*] ፀሐይ
                  ፡ ወይሴስል ፡ መንሱተ ፡ መዐቱ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ እምነ ፡ እስራኤል ።
verses.translation: And the Lord said to Moses, Take all the princes of the people, and make them examples of judgment for the Lord in the face of the sun, and the anger of the Lord shall be turned away from Israel.

translations.lxx: And the Lord said to Moses, Take all the princes of the people, and make them examples of judgment for the Lord in the face of the sun, and the anger of the Lord shall be turned away from Israel.
translations.kjv: And the LORD said unto Moses, Take all the heads of the people, and hang them up before the LORD against the sun, that the fierce anger of the LORD may be turned away from Israel.
translations.ron: Şi a zis Domnul către Moise: "Ia pe toate căpeteniile poporului şi le spânzură de copaci pentru Domnul înainte de asfinţitul soarelui, ca să se abată de la Israel iuţimea mâniei Domnului".
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπε Κύριος τῷ Μωυσῇ, λάβε πάντας τοὺς ἀρχηγοὺς τοῦ λαοῦ, καὶ παραδειγμάτισον αὐτοὺς Κυρίῳ κατέναντι τοῦ ἡλίου, καὶ ἀποστραφήσεται ὀργὴ θυμοῦ Κυρίου ἀπὸ Ἰσραήλ.

verses.geez:
ወይቤሎሙ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ለሕዝበ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ቅትሉ ፡ አሐዱ ፡ አሐዱ ፡ እምኔክሙ ፡ ሰብአ ፡ ቤትክሙ ፡ እለ ፡ ገብሩ ፡
                  ለቤዔል ፡ ፌጎር ።
verses.translation: And Moses said to the tribes of Israel, Slay ye every one his friend that is consecrated to Beel-phegor.

translations.lxx: And Moses said to the tribes of Israel, Slay ye every one his friend that is consecrated to Beel-phegor.
translations.kjv: And Moses said unto the judges of Israel, Slay ye every one his men that were joined unto Baalpeor.
translations.ron: Atunci a zis Moise către judecătorii lui Israel: "Ucideţi fiecare pe oamenii voştri care s-au lipit de Baal-Peor".
translations.grk: Καὶ εἶπε Μωυσῆς ταῖς φυλαῖς Ἰσραήλ, ἀποκτείνατε ἕκαστος τὸν οἰκεῖον αὐτοῦ τὸν τετελεσμένον τῷ Βεελφεγώρ.

verses.geez:
ወናሁ ፡ አሐዱ ፡ ብእሲ ፡ እምደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ መጽአ ፡ ወወሰዶ ፡ ለወልዱ ፡ ኀበ ፡ መድናዊት ፡ በቅድመ ፡ ሙሴ ፡
                  ወበቅድመ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ተዓይኒሆሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ወእሙንቱሰ ፡ ሀለዉ ፡ ይበክዩ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ኆኅተ ፡ ደብተራ ፡ ዘመርጡል
                  ።
verses.translation: And, behold, a man of the children of Israel came and brought his brother to a Madianitish woman before Moses, and before all the congregation of the children of Israel; and they were weeping at the door of the tabernacle of witness.

translations.lxx: And, behold, a man of the children of Israel came and brought his brother to a Madianitish woman before Moses, and before all the congregation of the children of Israel; and they were weeping at the door of the tabernacle of witness.
translations.kjv: And, behold, one of the children of Israel came and brought unto his brethren a Midianitish woman in the sight of Moses, and in the sight of all the congregation of the children of Israel, who were weeping before the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
translations.ron: Dar iată oarecare din fiii lui Israel a venit şi a adus între fraţii săi o madianită, în ochii lui Moise şi în ochii întregii obşti a fiilor lui Israel, când plângeau ei la uşa cortului adunării.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἰδοὺ ἄνθρωπος τῶν υἱῶν Ἰσραὴλ ἐλθὼν προσήγαγε τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ πρὸς τὴν Μαδιανίτιν ἐναντίον Μωυσῆ, καὶ ἐναντίον πάσης συναγωγῆς υἱῶν Ἰσραήλ· αὐτοὶ δὲ ἔκλαιον παρὰ τὴν θύραν τῆς σκηνῆς τοῦ μαρτυρίου.

verses.geez:
ወሶበ ፡ ርእየ ፡ ፊንሕስ ፡ ወልደ ፡ እልዓዛር ፡ ወልደ ፡ አሮን ፡ ካህን ፡ ተንሥአ ፡ እምነ ፡ ማእከለ ፡ ትዕይንት ፡
                  ወነሥአ ፡ ረምሐ ፡ ውስተ ፡ እዴሁ ።
verses.translation: And Phinees the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, saw it, and rose out of the midst of the congregation, and took a javelin in his hand,

translations.lxx: And Phinees the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, saw it, and rose out of the midst of the congregation, and took a javelin in his hand,
translations.kjv: And when Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, saw it, he rose up from among the congregation, and took a javelin in his hand;
translations.ron: Atunci Finees, fiul lui Eleazar, fiul preotului Aaron, văzând aceasta, s-a sculat din mijlocul obştii şi, luând în mână lancea sa,
translations.grk: Καὶ ἰδὼν Φινεὲς υἱὸς Ἐλεάζαρ υἱοῦ Ἀαρὼν τοῦ ἱερέως, ἐξανέστη ἐκ μέσου τῆς συναγωγῆς, καὶ λαβὼν σειρομάστην ἐν τῇ χειρὶ,

verses.geez:
ወቦአ ፡ ወተለዎ ፡ ለውእቱ ፡ ብእሲ ፡ እስራኤላዊ ፡ ውስተ ፡ እቶን ፡ ወረገዞሙ ፡ ለክልኤሆሙ ፡ ለውእቱ ፡ ብእሲ ፡
                  እስራኤላዊ ፡ ወለይእቲ ፡ ብእሲት ፡ መድናዊት ፡ እንተ ፡ መንገለ ፡ ሕምሳ ፡ ወሐደገ ፡ መቅሠፍት ፡ እምደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ።
verses.translation: and went in after the Israelitish man into the chamber, and pierced them both through, both the Israelitish man, and the woman through her womb; and the plague was stayed from the children of Israel.

translations.lxx: and went in after the Israelitish man into the chamber, and pierced them both through, both the Israelitish man, and the woman through her womb; and the plague was stayed from the children of Israel.
translations.kjv: And he went after the man of Israel into the tent, and thrust both of them through, the man of Israel, and the woman through her belly. So the plague was stayed from the children of Israel.
translations.ron: A intrat după israelit în sălaş şi i-a străpuns pe amândoi, pe israelit şi pe femeie, în pântece; şi a încetat pedepsirea fiilor lui Israel.
translations.grk: εἰσῆλθεν ὀπίσω τοῦ ἀνθρώπου τοῦ Ἰσραηλίτου εἰς τὴν κάμινον, καὶ ἀπεκέντησεν ἀμφοτέρους, τόν τε ἄνθρωπον τὸν Ἰσραηλίτην, καὶ τὴν γυναῖκα διὰ τῆς μήτρας αὐτῆς· καὶ ἐπαύσατο ἡ πληγὴ ἀπὸ υἱῶν Ἰσραήλ.

verses.geez: ወኮኑ ፡ እለ ፡ ሞቱ ፡ በውስተ ፡ መቅሠፍት ፡ ፪፻-፻፵፻ ።
verses.translation: And those that died in the plague were four and twenty thousand.

translations.lxx: And those that died in the plague were four and twenty thousand.
translations.kjv: And those that died in the plague were twenty and four thousand.
translations.ron: Cei ce au murit de pedeapsa aceasta au fost douăzeci şi patru de mii.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐγένοντο οἱ τεθνηκότες ἐν τῇ πληγῇ, τέσσαρες καὶ εἴκοσι χιλιάδες.

verses.translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,

translations.lxx: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
translations.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
translations.ron: Şi a grăit Domnul cu Moise şi a zis:
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐλάλησε Κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν, λέγων,

verses.geez:
ፊንሕስ ፡ ወልደ ፡ እልዓዛር ፡ ወልደ ፡ አሮን ፡ ካህን ፡ አኅደገኒ ፡ መዐትየ ፡ እምነ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ እስመ ፡
                  ቀንአ ፡ ሊተ ፡ ቅንአትየ ፡ ላዕሌሆሙ ፡ ወኢያጥፋእክዎሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ በቀንእየ ።
verses.translation: Phinees the son of Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest has caused my wrath to cease from the children of Israel, when I was exceedingly jealous among them, and I did not consume the children of Israel in my jealousy.

translations.lxx: Phinees the son of Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest has caused my wrath to cease from the children of Israel, when I was exceedingly jealous among them, and I did not consume the children of Israel in my jealousy.
translations.kjv: Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, hath turned my wrath away from the children of Israel, while he was zealous for my sake among them, that I consumed not the children of Israel in my jealousy.
translations.ron: "Finees, feciorul lui Eleazar, fiul preotului Aaron, a abătut mânia Mea de la fiii lui Israel, râvnind între ei pentru Mine, şi n-am mai pierdut pe fiii lui Israel în mânia Mea;
translations.grk: Φινεὲς υἱὸς Ἐλεάζαρ υἱοῦ Ἀαρὼν τοῦ ἱερέως κατέπαυσε τὸν θυμόν μου ἀπὸ υἱῶν Ἰσραὴλ, ἐν τῷ ζηλῶσαί μου τὸν ζῆλον ἐν αὐτοῖς, καὶ οὐκ ἐξανήλωσα τοὺς υἱοὺς Ἰσραὴλ ἐν τῷ ζήλῳ μου.

verses.geez: ወከመዝ ፡ እቤ ፡ ናሁ ፡ እሁቦ ፡ ሕገ ፡ ሰላም ፤
verses.translation: Thus do thou say to him, Behold, I give him a covenant of peace:

translations.lxx: Thus do thou say to him, Behold, I give him a covenant of peace:
translations.kjv: Wherefore say, Behold, I give unto him my covenant of peace:
translations.ron: De aceea spune-i că voi încheia cu el legământul Meu de pace,
translations.grk: Οὕτως εἰπον, ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ δίδωμι αὐτῷ διαθήκην εἰρήνης,

verses.geez:
ወይኩኖ ፡ ሎቱ ፡ ወለዘርኡ ፡ እምድኅሬሁ ፡ ሕገ ፡ [ክህነት ፡] ዘለዓለም ፡ እስመ ፡ ቀንአ ፡ ለአምላኩ ፡ ወአስተስረየ
                  ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ።
verses.translation: and he and his seed after him shall have a perpetual covenant of priesthood, because he was zealous for his God, and made atonement for the children of Israel.

translations.lxx: and he and his seed after him shall have a perpetual covenant of priesthood, because he was zealous for his God, and made atonement for the children of Israel.
translations.kjv: And he shall have it, and his seed after him, even the covenant of an everlasting priesthood; because he was zealous for his God, and made an atonement for the children of Israel.
translations.ron: Şi va fi pentru el şi pentru urmaşii lui de după el legământ de preoţie veşnică, căci a arătat râvnă pentru Dumnezeul său şi a ispăşit păcatul fiilor lui Israel".
translations.grk: καὶ ἔσται αὐτῷ καὶ τῷ σπέρματι αὐτοῦ μετʼ αὐτὸν διαθήκη ἱερατείας αἰωνία, ἀνθʼ ὧν ἐζήλωσεν τῷ Θεῷ αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἐξιλάσατο περὶ τῶν υἱῶν Ἰσραήλ.

verses.geez:
ወስሙ ፡ ለውእቱ ፡ ብእሲ ፡ እስራኤላዊ ፡ ዘተቀትለ ፡ ዝንብሪ ፡ ወልደ ፡ ሐሎ ፡ መልአከ ፡ ቤተ ፡ አበዊሆሙ ፡ ዘስምዖን
                  ።
verses.translation: Now the name of the smitten Israelitish man, who was smitten with the Madianitish woman, was Zambri son of Salmon, prince of a house of the tribe of Symeon.

translations.lxx: Now the name of the smitten Israelitish man, who was smitten with the Madianitish woman, was Zambri son of Salmon, prince of a house of the tribe of Symeon.
translations.kjv: Now the name of the Israelite that was slain, even that was slain with the Midianitish woman, was Zimri, the son of Salu, a prince of a chief house among the Simeonites.
translations.ron: Numele israelitului ucis, care a fost omorât cu madianita, era Zimri, fiul lui Salu, căpetenia seminţiei lui Simeon;
translations.grk: Τὸ δὲ ὄνομα τοῦ ἀνθρώπου τοῦ Ἰσραηλείτου τοῦ πεπληγότος, ὃς ἐπλήγη μετὰ τῆς Μαδιανίτιδος, Ζαμβρὶ, υἱὸς Σαλμὼν, ἄρχων οἴκου πατριᾶς τῶν Συμεών.

verses.geez:
ወስማ ፡ ለይእቲ ፡ ብእሲት ፡ መድናዊት ፡ እንተ ፡ ተቀትለት ፡ ከስቢ ፡ ወለተ ፡ ሱር ፡ መልአኮሙ ፡ ለሕዝበ ፡ ሳሞት ፡
                  ዘቤተ ፡ አበዊሆሙ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ለምድያም ።
verses.translation: And the name of the Madianitish woman who was smitten, was Chasbi, daughter of Sur, a prince of the nation of Ommoth: it is a chief house among the people of Madiam.

translations.lxx: And the name of the Madianitish woman who was smitten, was Chasbi, daughter of Sur, a prince of the nation of Ommoth: it is a chief house among the people of Madiam.
translations.kjv: And the name of the Midianitish woman that was slain was Cozbi, the daughter of Zur; he was head over a people, and of a chief house in Midian.
translations.ron: Iar numele madianitei ucise era Cozbi, fiica lui Ţur, căpetenia unei seminţii ieşită dintr-o casă patriarhală din Madian.
translations.grk: Καὶ ὄνομα τῇ γυναικὶ τῇ Μαδιανίτιδι τῇ πεπληγυίᾳ, Χασβὶ, θυγάτηρ Σοὺρ, ἄρχοντος ἔθνους Ὀμμὼθ· οἴκου πατριᾶς ἐστι τῶν Μαδιάμ.

verses.geez: ወነበቦ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ ወይቤሎ ፡ ንግሮሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ወበሎሙ ፤
verses.translation: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying, Speak to the children of Israel, saying,

translations.lxx: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying, Speak to the children of Israel, saying,
translations.kjv: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
translations.ron: Şi a grăit Domnul cu Moise şi a zis: "Vorbeşte fiilor lui Israel şi le zi:
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐλάλησε Κύριος πρὸς Μωυσῆν, λέγων, λάλησον τοῖς υἱοῖς Ἰσραὴλ, λέγων,

verses.translation: Plague the Madianites as enemies, and smite them,

translations.lxx: Plague the Madianites as enemies, and smite them,
translations.kjv: Vex the Midianites, and smite them:
translations.ron: Socotiţi pe Madianiţi duşmanii voştri şi omorâţi-i, bateţi-i, că s-au purtat cu voi duşmănos întru vicleşugul lor,
translations.grk: ἐχθραίνετε τοῖς Μαδιηναίοις καὶ πατάξατε αὐτοὺς,

verses.geez:
እስመ ፡ እሙንቱኒ ፡ ይፃረሩክሙ ፡ በጕሕሉት ፡ ወኵሉ ፡ ዘይትጐሐለውክሙ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ፌጎር ፡ ወበእንተ ፡ ከስቢ ፡ ወለተ
                  ፡ መልአከ ፡ ምድያም ፡ እኅቶሙ ፡ እንተ ፡ ተቀትለት ፡ አመ ፡ ዕለተ ፡ መቅሠፍት ፡ በበይነ ፡ ፌጎር ።
verses.translation: for they are enemies to you by the treachery wherein they ensnare you through Phogor, and through Chasbi their sister, daughter of a prince of Madiam, who was smitten in the day of the plague because of Phogor.

translations.lxx: for they are enemies to you by the treachery wherein they ensnare you through Phogor, and through Chasbi their sister, daughter of a prince of Madiam, who was smitten in the day of the plague because of Phogor.
translations.kjv: For they vex you with their wiles, wherewith they have beguiled you in the matter of Peor, and in the matter of Cozbi, the daughter of a prince of Midian, their sister, which was slain in the day of the plague for Peor’s sake.
translations.ron: Ademenindu-vă cu Peor şi cu Cozbi, sora lor, fiica unei căpetenii a Madianiţilor, care a fost ucisă în ziua urgiei celei pentru Peor".
translations.grk: ὅτι ἐχθραίνουσιν αὐτοὶ ὑμῖν ἐν δολιότητι, ὅσα δολιοῦσιν ὑμᾶς διὰ Φογὼρ, καὶ διὰ Χασβὶ θυγατέρα ἄρχοντος Μαδιὰμ ἀδελφὴν αὐτῶν, τὴν πεπληγυῖαν ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῆς πληγῆς διὰ Φογώρ.
